title_original: Iris Projects Opening New Space in Alserkal Avenue in 2027

blocks.text: Iris Projects recently announced its expansion to Dubai with the opening of Expérimentale, a new space in Alserkal Avenue in 2027.

Expérimentale will offer a space where artists can experiment beyond traditional exhibition conventions. It will support large-scale commissions and installations by artists represented by Iris Projects, giving them opportunities to test ideas and create at new scales with works made specifically for Expérimentale. The first commission will be presented during Alserkal Art Week in spring 2027.

Expérimentale will also include public programming with limited-edition works, artist-designed objects, collaborations and gatherings. The space will be designed by Dubai-based architectural designer Lea Daniel.

Maryam Al Falasi, Founder of Iris Projects, shares the inspiration behind the space: “Expérimentale grew out of a desire to give artists greater freedom to take risks and realise work at a scale that is not always possible within a conventional gallery programme. As their practices have developed, we have looked for new ways to support their ambitions. Opening at Alserkal Avenue connects Iris Projects to a vital cultural community in Dubai, while giving Expérimentale a distinct purpose: commissioning ambitious new work and creating a more informal setting in which artists and audiences can come together. We want to grow with the UAE’s art scene and help shape what comes next, rather than simply respond to it.”

Expérimentale will complement Iris Projects’ existing gallery located in MiZa, Abu Dhabi. Founded by Maryam Al Falasi in late 2024, Iris Projects supports emerging and established intergenerational artists from and connected to the Gulf.
